s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain and gastrointestinal bleeding with a mass in the small intestine
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

raw.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain and gastrointestinal bleeding with a mass in the small intestine
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells

shortlist.label: Clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and presence of a polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass

shortlist.label: Carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: presence of a small intestine mass and iron-deficiency anemia, but less likely due to negative chromogranin

shortlist.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
shortlist.why_kept: patchy synaptophysin expression and presence of a small intestine mass, but less likely due to negative chromogranin

shortlist.label: Ganglioneuroma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of a small intestine mass and strong positivity for S100 protein, but less likely due to lack of typical ganglioneuroma morphology

raw.rationale: The tumor's strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, along with its microscopic features of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, are characteristic of clear cell sarcoma.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: Negative CD117 and DOG1 immunohistochemical stains argue against this diagnosis

rejected.label: Carcinoid tumor
rejected.why: Lack of chromogranin expression and absence of typical carcinoid morphology

rejected.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
rejected.why: Patchy synaptophysin expression is not sufficient for diagnosis, and other neuroendocrine markers are negative

rejected.label: Ganglioneuroma
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histological features do not align with ganglioneuroma, which typically presents with a more benign course and distinct histology
